title: Area formula for a piece of a cone over a unit curve
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, reals r₀, s with 0 < s < r₀, every γ : ℝ → ℝ^P that is C¹ and injective on (−s, s) with ‖γ(α)‖ = 1, ⟨γ(α), γ′(α)⟩ = 0 and γ′(α) ≠ 0 for every α ∈ (−s, s), and every h : ℝ^P → ℝ: with R := (r₀ − s, r₀ + s) × (−s, s) ⊆ ℝ × ℝ and S := {tγ(α) : (t, α) ∈ R}, the Bochner integral of h over S with respect to H² := μHE[2] equals the Lebesgue integral over R of t‖γ′(α)‖·h(tγ(α)) d(t, α).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (r₀ s : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P) (h : Euclid P → ℝ), 0 < s → s < r₀ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Ioo (-s) s) → InjOn γ (Ioo (-s) s) → (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖γ α‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℝ (γ α) (deriv γ α) = 0 ∧ deriv γ α ≠ 0) → ∫ x in (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • γ q.2) '' (Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ×ˢ Ioo (-s) s), h x ∂μHE[2] = ∫ q in Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ×ˢ Ioo (-s) s, q.1 * ‖deriv γ q.2‖ * h (q.1 • γ q.2)
